title: Featured Projects
subtitle: Selected work spanning mobile, backend, and product delivery

items.name: My Gym Orbit
items.overview: A cross-platform fitness management application enabling users to manage memberships, track workouts, and monitor fitness activities in real time.
responsibilities: Architected the application using MVVM and BLoC state management for scalable, maintainable modules.
Implemented automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Firebase App Distribution.
Built comprehensive error handling, API abstraction, and reliable state management patterns.
challenges: Designing a modular architecture that remained maintainable as features expanded across memberships, workouts, and live activity tracking.
Reducing deployment friction while keeping release quality high across Android and iOS.

items.name: Anan Jewels
items.overview: A B2B jewelry e-commerce platform enabling retailers to seamlessly browse, manage, and purchase diamond jewelry inventory.
responsibilities: Developed the full mobile experience and integrated backend API services for wholesale purchasing workflows.
Architected a scalable product catalog with advanced search, filtering, and category-based navigation.
Automated build and release workflows using GitHub Actions and Firebase App Distribution.
challenges: Improving product discoverability for wholesale buyers across large diamond jewelry inventories.
Streamlining secure authentication and order management for B2B purchasing flows.

items.name: The Super Test
items.overview: An education and exam-prep learning app for aspirants targeting SSC GD, Railway, and other government competitive exams — built with Clean Architecture and BLoC, following the same scalable patterns used in My Gym Orbit.
responsibilities: Built learning and practice flows for SSC GD, Railway, and related competitive exam content using Clean Architecture with BLoC.
Structured domain, data, and presentation layers for quizzes, mock tests, and study modules with clear dependency rules.
challenges: Organizing large exam-oriented question banks and subject modules while keeping the architecture modular and testable.
Delivering a smooth learning experience across practice tests, progress tracking, and content updates.
